hard_conflicts.description: WinUI and Flutter Desktop cannot act as simultaneous primary desktop authorities.
hard_conflicts.resolution: Select exactly one desktop framework authority based on target platform and project requirements.

hard_conflicts.description: Flutter and Expo cannot act as simultaneous mobile authorities.
hard_conflicts.resolution: Isolate the repository to either Dart/Flutter or React Native/Expo.

hard_conflicts.description: Native Android and Native iOS cannot act as simultaneous implementation authorities for a single codebase.
hard_conflicts.resolution: Separate native implementation tasks by target platform surface or use cross-platform layer.

hard_conflicts.description: React lifecycle and hooks patterns cannot be applied to Flutter widget trees.
hard_conflicts.resolution: Enforce Flutter native State and InheritedWidget/Riverpod/Bloc architecture.

hard_conflicts.description: Electron IPC and security architecture cannot be applied to Tauri Rust commands.
hard_conflicts.resolution: Use Tauri capabilities and IPC command macros for Tauri; use contextIsolation and preload scripts for Electron.

hard_conflicts.description: Taste Skill and Anthropic frontend-design cannot be activated simultaneously for creative direction.
hard_conflicts.resolution: Choose Taste Skill for marketing/brand or Anthropic frontend-design for bespoke UI direction.

conditional_warnings.description: Activating both UI Craft (design system) and Impeccable (critic) incurs excessive token context.
conditional_warnings.guidance: Use UI Craft only for token/system design, and switch to Impeccable only during post-implementation critique.

conditional_warnings.description: Activating Browser Use alongside Firecrawl when static retrieval is sufficient causes latency and high resource usage.
conditional_warnings.guidance: Prefer Firecrawl for static documents and documentation. Only activate Browser Use when dynamic JavaScript or authentication is required.
